name: Combined Immunodeficiency due to LCK Deficiency

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: LCK Deficiency Combined Immunodeficiency Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in the LCK gene
Severe T-cell lymphopenia with impaired T-cell activation and proliferation
Early onset of recurrent severe infections involving bacterial, viral, and fungal pathogens
Reduced serum immunoglobulin levels (IgG, IgA, and IgM)
Low or absent T-cell receptor excision circles (TRECs) indicating impaired thymic output

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of biallelic pathogenic LCK variants plus severe T-cell lymphopenia and clinical history of recurrent severe infections
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of genetic, immunological, and clinical data.

pathognomonic.notes: Profound reduction in circulating T lymphocytes
Defective T-cell receptor signaling due to LCK deficiency

common.notes: Persistent fungal infections of skin and mucous membranes
searchTerms: chronic yeast infections on skin and mucous

common.notes: Poor growth and weight gain in infancy
Persistent gastrointestinal symptoms due to infections or inflammation

occasional.notes: Painful mucosal lesions in the oral cavity
Enlarged lymph nodes due to immune dysregulation
Recurrent viral warts or herpes infections

rare.notes: Delayed milestones possibly secondary to chronic illness
Chronic lung scarring due to recurrent infections

laboratory: Severe T-cell lymphopenia on flow cytometry
Reduced serum immunoglobulin levels (IgG, IgA, IgM)
Absent or markedly reduced T-cell receptor excision circles (TRECs)
imaging: Chest radiographs showing recurrent pneumonia or bronchiectasis
other: Impaired T-cell proliferation assays in response to mitogens
Reduced phosphorylation of downstream TCR signaling molecules

distinguishingFeatures: SCID typically presents with absent T cells and B cells, whereas LCK deficiency shows T-cell lymphopenia with variable B-cell numbers
SCID often has more profound immunodeficiency with earlier fatality without treatment
Zap70 deficiency presents with defective T-cell signaling similar to LCK deficiency but involves mutations in the ZAP70 gene
Zap70 deficiency patients often have normal or elevated CD8+ T cells unlike LCK deficiency

redFlags: Early onset of severe, recurrent bacterial and fungal infections
Profound T-cell lymphopenia with impaired proliferation
Failure to thrive in infancy with hypogammaglobulinemia
references: Palacios EH, Weiss A. Function of the Src-family kinases, Lck and Fyn, in T-cell development and activation. Oncogene. 2004
Orphanet: Combined immunodeficiency due to LCK deficiency (ORPHA:280142)
Notarangelo LD. Primary immunodeficiencies. J Allergy Clin Immunol. 2010
